candidates.description: This feature vector represents grammatical prepositions and relational particles across multiple languages.
This vector represents common Spanish verbs, primarily in past and present tenses, along with frequent auxiliary and grammatical words.
This vector activates for tokens containing the Spanish root/morpheme "seg-" or phonetically and orthographically related variations.
This vector activates on various combinations of closing quotation marks and punctuation marks commonly found at the end of quoted sentences or dialogue.
This vector represents relative pronouns and subordinating conjunctions used to introduce clauses in Romance languages.
The tokens represent numeric digits or multi-digit integer IDs.
This vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "ab" and words containing it across various capitalizations and prefixes.
This feature vector represents prefixes or root morphemes associated with historical, cultural, and sociopolitical terminology.
This vector represents common Spanish verb stems and root prefixes denoting actions, movements, and states.
This vector represents modal verbs and concepts of possibility, permission, or obligation across multiple languages.
